params.body:
The role picker's Teacher on the demo was class teacher of Grade 1 A and Grade 4 at once. A class teacher leads one class, so a visitor stepping into "Teacher" saw a setup no school runs.

The persona now leads Grade 1 A only. Grade 1 rather than Grade 4 because the Learn progress is seeded for Grade 1 to 3: with Grade 4 the persona's Progress page would be empty. Grade 4 keeps the class teacher drawn from the pool, and all eleven classes stay visible to the headmaster and the admin.

This shows on the demo after its next reset.

## Checked

On a locally seeded database: the persona has exactly one class, every class of the current year has exactly one class teacher, and 13 pupils of Grade 1 A have Learn progress.

No test is added: no test runs the demo seeder. Full suite: 531 tests pass, 2 skipped.
params.title: Demo: the Teacher persona leads one class
